summary: AdventureLog is a self-hosted application designed for tracking travel and planning trips. It helps users organise their journeys, itineraries, and location data within a centralised dashboard.
goodFor: It is well-suited for individuals who want to manage their personal travel data independently rather than relying on commercial cloud-based trip planners.
watchOut: As a relatively young project under active development, you may encounter breaking changes between releases and less comprehensive documentation than mature alternatives.
deployNotes: Since it is distributed as a Docker container, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your travel data and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
